costs.body: A BMW M4 Competition engine rebuild starts from £5,500, whether your car has the S55 or the S58. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
